_note: Settings for the hosted version. Change and redeploy. Prices for working out costs are in prices.json.
_mode: beta: invited users only. New accounts get no free questions; they redeem a code or join the waiting list. open: anyone can sign up and gets trialQuestions free.
_callsPerQuestion: Claude calls allowed per question in a set, counting first writes and regenerations: 1.5 means 30 calls for a 20-question set.
_maxWordsPerSet: The most teaching text one set can be written from. Checked in the browser and on the server.
